title: Context-dependent hard-constrained neural projection solver
coding_guidance: Edit only model.py; never modify eval.py/data.py/task_spec.json. Preserve solve(problem,config) returning a finite vector y. Enforce M@y=b and lower<=y<=upper. Optimize quadratic plus alpha*sin(y); never access hidden reference values.
metric_description: Median CPU wall-time includes OS/CPU noise; rerun tolerance 50%, not bitwise timings.
